title: Model-Agnostic FDR Control via Group Gaussian Mirror and Permutation SHAP
abstract: arXiv:2608.00989v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most FDR-controlled feature selection methods are designed for coordinate-wise hypotheses, where each feature has a single weight or importance score. This abstraction fails in sequential and grouped models, where one original feature is represented by a block of sub-features, such as lags, recurrent states, or attention-based interactions. We propose a grouped-feature FDR control framework for such settings. For grouped linear models, we construct null-symmetric block-level mirror statistics with matrix-valued perturbations. For neural sequential models, we combine Permutation SHAP derivatives as model-agnostic block-level importance scores with kernel-based dependence measure. The framework is model-agnostic across network architectures, does not require specifying the covariate distribution, and reduces to Gaussian Mirror or Neural Gaussian Mirror when the block size is one. We prove FDR control for low- and high-dimensional group

translated_title: 基于组高斯镜像与置换SHAP的模型无关FDR控制
translated_abstract: 大多数FDR控制的特征选择方法是为坐标级假设设计的，即每个特征只有单一的权重或重要性得分。这种抽象在序列模型和分组模型中会失效，因为在这些模型中，一个原始特征由一组子特征块表示，例如滞后项、循环状态或基于注意力的交互。我们针对此类场景提出了一个分组特征的FDR控制框架。对于分组线性模型，我们构造了具有矩阵值扰动的零对称块级镜像统计量。对于神经序列模型，我们将置换SHAP导数作为模型无关的块级重要性得分，并结合基于核方法的依赖性度量。该框架在各种网络架构上都是模型无关的，不需要指定协变量分布，且当块大小为1时可退化为高斯镜像或神经高斯镜像方法。我们证明了该方法在低维和高维分组设定下的FDR控制性质。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向分组和序列模型的模型无关FDR控制框架，通过组高斯镜像统计量与置换SHAP块级重要性得分相结合，在低维和高维设定下实现了对原始特征块级别的误发现率控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-agnostic FDR control framework for grouped and sequential models, combining group Gaussian mirror statistics with Permutation SHAP block-level importance scores to achieve FDR control over original features at the block level in both low- and high-dimensional settings.
